limitations: Exact displayed threefold and characteristic two only. No generalized assertion for arbitrary polynomial conic bundles; no independent audit; possible unindexed prior calculation of explicit Brauer class.
scientific_integrity: Characteristic-two nonsplitting proven by an explicit valuation argument, not finite enumeration. The named Fano threefold and discriminant are credited to Tanaka; formal quaternion theory and the distinct totally singular example credited to Auel et al.
title: A nonsplit conic projection on a rational characteristic-two Fano threefold
